sections.heading: Type power
lines: Ancient Power, Barrage, Continental Crush, Psychic, Secret Power, Shattered Psyche, and Strength also count as Rock for type matchups.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Ancient Power, Continental Crush, Fake Out, Feint, Feint Attack, First Impression, Kowtow Cleave, Psychic, Secret Power, Shadow Sneak, Shattered Psyche, Smart Strike, Strength, Sucker Punch, Thunderclap, and Upper Hand: 1.5× stronger.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Psychic-type.
Secret Power can lower the target's Defense.

sections.heading: Abilities
lines: Stance Change: Defense +1 when it enters.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Synthetic Seed: Special Attack +1 and gains a special effect.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
